children: has announced the closing of its previously disclosed
The shares were sold by OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l., an entity indirectly owned by funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, L.P.
Following the transaction, Oaktree retains beneficial ownership of approximately 11.06% of TORM's Class A common shares.
Additionally, the selling shareholder granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1.35M Class A common shares.
TORM did not issue or sell any shares in the transaction and received no proceeds from the offering.
